text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Run... faster than anyone else...! Get 
ahead of everyone... to the goal!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... Endure it... Push past... the 
pain...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Victory for everyone...! It has to be 
now—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(—I won't let you go. What lies ahead for 
you is not despair, but...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (This is the future I will lead them to—!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Ruby...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it means risking everything, I 
want to repay the favor right now. ...That 
is one choice. However—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Is that... really your very best? Is that 
an answer sufficient to repay everything?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...! But I... now is my only—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"If the answer you reached after thinking 
to the absolute limit is merely 'for 
now'... then I will show you hope."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: “—Just as someone once did for me.”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I have found a different path. A new 
mission, and a step even further—toward a 
more brilliant future."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"To see this path through to the end is my 
pride—my way of repaying everything I have 
been given—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "It's my passion."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...! ...What incredible running—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...Me too... I want to show everyone—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Is K.S.Miracle losing momentum here?! And 
taking the lead is...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Daiichi Ruby! Daiichi Ruby! Daiichi 
Ruby with a tremendous burst of speed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Daiichi Ruby!! Showing off 
overwhelming speed, it's the ‘Splendid 
Clan,’ Daiichi Ruby!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What... what overwhelming speed! This is 
the power of the 'Illustrious Family'...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. You really are... 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, I really wouldn't have 
minded burning through everything I had 
today."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was certain I wouldn't be able to run 
for long. If all I have is the present... 
then I'll bet everything on the right now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Your running was so blindingly 
brilliant... It made me realize there's 
still so much more I can do.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running and show everyone the 
future. Even surpassing your speed.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... That's so frustrating.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's strange. I feel completely 
refreshed.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'll become stronger.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"So my body can keep up with this speed, 
I'll retrain it from scratch."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So that my feelings, and I myself... don't 
break.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Swan Stakes... That's the race I'm 
entering next."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, I'd love to run with you 
again.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Next time, I'll reach the finish line 
faster than you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I will consider it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Congraaaats!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Good job Miracle, good job everyone! And 
congrats to the young lady!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That was soooo... freaking cool!! 
Seriously insane, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But hey! I've got my vibes all pumped up, 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"The Mile Championship! You're totally 
coming, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(The Mile Championship... The pinnacle 
race to determine the mile champion—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...If that is where everyone shall 
gather."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
All the brilliance we've cultivated up to 
this point— I shall see to it that it 
bears fruit.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Me too! Mind if I join in?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fuuuu! Miracle's partying it up tooâª

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes, obvs☆ Nothing to do but party with 
everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Both of them... are pushing themselves to 
greater heights just to compete with me.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Therefore, I too can aim—for even greater 
heights.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Ojo? Can you get hype with 
us!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Since I cannot comprehend what you are 
saying, I am unable to provide a response.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pien!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However... I look forward to working with 
you."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Paooo—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh, so you're joining in?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you triumph over me, I will simply 
strive to surpass that run even further—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please show me a wonderful run. If you do, 
I shall show you my passion in return." 
his is a typical 
Vivlos/Gentildonna/refined tone, likely 
Gentildonna -> "show me a wonderful run...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: !! Milady's passion...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see! I wanna see, I wanna see, I 
wanna seeee~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"My vibes! I'm givin' 'em all to you, 
Milady!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have high expectations.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Everything has been arranged, so please 
head over that way. The attendant is 
waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
H-Helios-san! That's off-limits, please 
come back!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Okaaay☆

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Helios really is such a fun girl.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I've got to do my best too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, um... Ruby?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No. —Never mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is the Mile 
Championship... A race to definitively 
crown the Mile King, and truly a fitting 
culmination of everything so far.
choice_data_list:
(Everyone's presence helps Ruby reach even 
greater heights.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby continues to grow, elevated 
by her rivals. But as her Trainer, am I 
truly having a positive impact on her—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Mile CS" would likely be the 
culmination of it all. I resolved right 
then and there to produce results worthy 
of being her Trainer.
